name: Grouped bar
reader_question: How do two or three comparable measures differ within each category?
relationship: Side-by-side magnitudes of 2–3 series within each category on one zero-based axis.
use_when: Each category has two or three values in the same unit and at the same cut-off
Within-category contrast matters more than a total
avoid_when: Series are parts of a whole — use a composition form
There are more than three series or six categories — use a table or small-multiples

data_contract.notes: Measure and unit shared by all series
One value per series, same order as series

units: One unit throughout; the value axis starts at zero.

editable: Clustered column chart with embedded workbook (Edit Data)
not_data_bound: Legend chips and the unit caption are native shapes and text, not chart elements

table_alternative: A category-by-series table with the unit in the header.
variations: Horizontal grouping for long category names
Highlighting one series in the accent colour
limitations: Three series across six categories is the legible limit
Series are neutral tones; order in the legend carries identity

excluded_alternatives.reason: Implies the series sum to a meaningful total
Two axes invite false visual correlation
